supporting_observations.claim: The PowerShell window reported by the user was spawned by IT administrator sam.okafor to perform workstation patching.
The PowerShell process executed a script from a known administrative share: \\FILE-NWD-01\Admin\Apply-Updates.ps1.
The PowerShell activity led to the execution of a legitimate Windows Update standalone installer (wusa.exe) to apply a patch (kb5047001).
The update process contacted legitimate Windows Update domains via the proxy.
The activity occurred at 13:42 UTC, which is consistent with the user's report of a window appearing around 13:40 UTC.
